text: Ahti was an unbound water elemental located at the Steam Pools in Feralas.

__NOTOC__ Agthia was an Ascended kyrian located in Bastion. The previous Paragon of Courage, Agthia gave her life defending Bastion from an invasion by the forces of the Void led by Tezulat the Annihilator. The area where she made her final stand was named Agthia's Repose in honor of her memory and sacrifice.
Al'satt is a necromancer who was encountered by Brann Bronzebeard. He told the dwarf explorer about the Lich King, the Frozen Throne, and its obelisks.

__NOTOC__ Alchemist Flemthroat is a Forsaken located at the Ruby Feast in Valdrakken on Thursdays. Next to her, she has her Mini Herb Dryer, a stack of Signed Autographs and Phlegmthroat's Specialty Brew. On her buffet table, one may find Cinna-Cinderbloom Tea, Lemon Silverleaf Tea and Aruunem Berrytarts.
__NOTOC__ The Aldrachi Revenant is an aldrachi voidwraith created by Caria Felsoul from a Felsoul Legionnaire in the Lost Temple on the Broken Shore during Vengeance Will Be Ours.

Alia Darkleaf is a night elf first seen in the Darkmoon Faire on the Darkmoon Island. She had traveled to the island to learn the ways of warlocks from Madam Shadow due to her own ambition. She was seen assisting Initiate Undertide with her summoning ritual, then with the other initiates Darkleaf was witnessing Madam Shadow's rituals. After Madam Shadow was revealed to be Lord Banehollow and the dreadlord was defeated, Alia met with the surviving initiates in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

Alwys Cogpsin was the tinker supporting the company called the "Rolling Thunder" as they rode into battle against the Horde in siege wagons. When the archers complained about the jostling of the vehicles affecting the accuracy of their shots, Alwys Cogspin constructed a set of gears and counterweights that compensated for the shocks and jolts of firing while in motion. He had invented the bow stabilizer. When the "Rolling Thunder" was honored as one of the most effective units in the Second War against the Horde, the commander was quick to acknowledge how much of their success came from Cogspin's devices.

The Amalgam of Souls is the first boss in the Grand Sepulcher of Black Rook Hold. This creature is an amalgamation of the spirits of Lady Velandras Ravencrest, Lord Etheldrin Ravencrest, and Staellis Rivermoor.
__NOTOC__ Ambermill Witchaloks are humans found in Ambermill of Silverpine Forest. These casters are capable of summoning Wolfoids, which are friendly to players, or the powerfully elite Doomskull.

Ambrose Boltspark is a gnome mage serving as the Grand Champion of Gnomeregan in the Silver Covenant Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament. He participates in the Trial of the Champion. He was present during Death Rising.
__NOTOC__ Amethyzar the Glittering is an earth elemental located in the Waking Shores.

Ancient Shadowmoon Spirit is an orc ghost quest giver located at the Altar of Shadows in Shadowmoon Valley. Little does the player realize, until after completing the quests, that the spirit is actually that of Teron Gorefiend, the first death knight known to be created. He then takes over the player's body and uses it to kill his captor.

Anvil Stormglaive is a dwarven hero celebrated in Stormwind. On his holy birthday, the light is praised, and the ale pours freely for every dwarf in the city. He is apparently a paladin or priest of the light.
Anub'ar Venomancers are nerubian venomancers that can be found in Azjol-Nerub. They take part in the Anub'arak encounter.

Antonius was one of the One Hundred magi of Arathor. He, Decindra, and their apprentices chose to accompany Thoradin on his quest to find the origins of humanity, which ended in disaster when they broke the seals on the Tomb of Tyr and were killed by Zakajz the Corruptor.
]] appears in place of his corpse.]] Araj the Summoner, the former leader of the Scholomance, is the ruler of the Ruins of Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
__NOTOC__ Aqueous is a water elemental located at the Hidden Reef in the draenei-aligned zone of Bloodmyst Isle.
Aqua Dancers are water spirits that are found in the Trickling Passage in the Stormstout Brewery. They are apparently mind controlling the Sodden Hozen Brawler.

__NOTOC__ Apprentice Rosalyn is a blood elf warlock and quest giver initially found just inside the southern entrance of Mucksnout Den in Highmountain. She and her mentor, Soulkeeper Uriah, were to transport a handful of Soul Chambers to Allari the Souleater in Azsuna, but while traveling through Mucksnout Den their caravan was attacked by a group of Mucksnout kobolds that stole the shards. Uriah insisted on going further into the cave to retrieve the chambers, leaving Rosalyn at the entrance, where she asks adventurers for aid in retrieving the shards, finding Uriah and later, after Uriah dies of his injuries, detaining three powerful demons that escaped from their soul chambers. After adve
Aqu'sirr is the first boss of Shrine of the Storm. It can create Aqualings.

Arcane elementals (also called arcane wraiths and mana elementals) are elementals composed of arcane energy. They are beings of pure mana. Mana surges are a type of arcane elementals, or another name for arcane elementals.

__NOTOC__ Arcanist Torseldori is a blood elf mage found outside Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula. He leads his battalion of Bloodmages that defend the Supply Caravan outside of Thrallmar. Infernal Invaders constantly attack the caravan, but the bloodmages and Arcanist Torseldori never cease to defeat them. They also will help whoever needs it fight a Fel Reaver that strays too close to town.

Arcanist Valtrois (pronounced "VAHL-twah") is a nightborne and prominent member of the Nightfallen faction of Suramar City in the Broken Isles. As one of the original members and leaders of the Nightfallen, Valtrois was heavily involved in the Nightfallen rebellion that raged through Suramar with the third coming of the Burning Legion. Alongside her leader First Arcanist Thalyssra, Valtrois and the other resistance fighters would spearhead the charge to topple the regime of Grand Magistrix Elisande and drive the demons from Suramar. Proud and somewhat haughty, Valtrois would be particularly instrumental in overseeing the development of the system of ley stations that fed much of the rebellio
Arcanor Prime is an arcane golem located at the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar in Azsuna.

__NOTOC__ Arcanist Malrodi is a nightborne found at The Gilded Market in the Court of Stars while the world quest Court of Stars: The Deceitful Student is available. Once a student of First Arcanist Thalyssra, Malrodi betrayed her former mistress. She was later assassinated by agents of Thalyssra.
Archmage Tervosh is a human quest giver located in the Theramore Isle tower in Dustwallow Marsh. He is a close friend and advisor to Jaina Proudmoore. To relax, he likes to tend to his herb garden.

:"I won't pretend that I don't wish you'd choose a more... typical line of work. But no matter what, you are my daughter, and I'll never forget that." Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver is a member of the Council of Six, the leaders of the Kirin Tor of Dalaran.

__NOTOC__ Archmage Evanor is an important member of the Kirin Tor who has been captured by the Blue dragonflight. After being freed from Beryl Point, she can be found on the top floor of the mage tower in Amber Ledge.

Archmage Trelane was once a studying wizard in the Tower of Arathor. There he created a defense system that will call Summoned Guardians to your aid if you use a prepared gem. It seems that this wasn't enough as he fled Stromgarde not long ago. He is the original master of Archmage Malin, who now sent Skuerto to recover some of Trelane's belongings from the ogre controlled part of Stromgarde Keep. According to Malin's Request, Trelane is located in Stormwind City.

Arcosin is a very rare Ancient of the Arcane, one of the few known in the Warcraft universe, and the only one that is friendly to players, albeit only to the Alliance. Arcosin is stationed at the Tower of Estulan, an outpost maintained by the Shen'dralar. With the return of the Shen'dralar to the kaldorei, and being the only night elves who use arcane magic, perhaps the association is only a natural fit.
__NOTOC__ Arcshaper Thorendis is a nightborne located in Suramar. He summons Arcane Minions.
Archmage Y'mera is a Lightforged draenei located on Krokuun and Eredath. She is one of the few Lightforged that is a mage, having been a student of the arcane since the days of the eredar on Argus.
Architect Xeeli is a necromancer of the House of Rituals located in northern Gluthern's Decay in Maldraxxus. She is one of three architects for Mor'Bitan's ritual on the Rotting Mound. __NOTOC__

Architect Halen is a necromancer of the House of Rituals located in southwestern Glutharn's Decay in Maldraxxus. He is one of three architects for Mor'Bitan's ritual on the Rotting Mound and is draining anima from nearby slain creatures via an Imbibing Anima Crystal. __NOTOC__

Architect Lye is a necromancer of the House of Rituals located in southern Gluthern's Decay in Maldraxxus. She is one of three architects for Mor'Bitan's ritual on the Rotting Mound and is draining anima from nearby slain creatures via an Imbibing Anima Crystal. __NOTOC__

Arkantus was an arcane elemental on the Broken Isles who used to be a guard for the ancient night elves. It was killed when the mages of Tirisgarde came searching for artifacts in forgotten vaults and reliquaries around the isles.
Arin'gore is a lich located in the Bony Spindles in Maldraxxus. He is summoned by using the Phylactery of Arin'gore.

Arnak Grimtotem is a tauren found near Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles. He was referred to as an outcast and was wanted for heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. To reach him, take the rope bridge on Darkcloud Pinnacle north toward the cliff wall near Razorfen Downs. Lakota Windsong is found in the nearby cave. He killed her brother and is forcing her to be his bride. When he is attacked, he summons Grimtotem Stompers, Grimtotem Reavers, and Grimtotem Geomancers to aid him in battle.

Armond Thaco is a wrathguard disguised as a human wandering the streets of Dalaran above the Broken Isles. He can be exposed by paladins wielding the Truthguard or by abilities to reveal demons. The real mage Armond Thaco is located as an undead skeletal mage in Tol Barad.

The Ashleaf sprites of the Timeless Isle tirelessly protect the vegetation of the island from the burning fury of Ordos and his minions. They also seem to have a curious relationship with the Crimsonscale Firestorm cloud serpents that dwell in the same area. The serpents seem top enjoy playing a game with the little wood men; they circle for hours, then assault one of the sprites' trees with a burst of fire, which causes the Ashleaf sprites to form a shield of leaves, deflecting the fire and warding off the would-be attacker. The sprites seem adapt at shielding their homes, and the cloud serpents do not seem to be interested in destroying the sprites themselves.
Ashraka is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Asmorda is a lich located in the Sepulcher of Knowledge in Maldraxxus.

Asthalor Duskmoon was a night elf Ashen druid located in Val'sharah. He was one of Delandros Shimmermoon's three most trusted Ashen, charged with carrying one of the Tel'andu Seeds that could renew the magical barriers protecting the Fangs of Ashamane. He was slain in Val'sharah by demons during the third invasion of the Burning Legion, but the seed was fortunately found on his corpse by a druid adventurer and brought to the Ashen leader.

__NOTOC__ Apprentice Telemancer Astrandis is a nightborne located in the Horde camp in Xibala in Zuldazar. He appears as Telemancer Astrandis in Emberwatch in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Astrandis worked with Examiner Tae'shara Bloodwatcher to find the Eye of Xibala. Using his knowledge of telemancy, he and the Speaker of the Horde investigated the ruins of Xibala.
Assembler Xertora is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Atal'ai tribe (or the Atal'ai), an extremist faction of the Hakkari, are worshipers of the Blood God Hakkar and are based within Temple of Atal'Hakkar. They are green or white skinned with green, purple, or white hair. The Atal'ai trolls are a tribe of dark casters, known for practicing forbidden magic, including necromancy which was taught to them by Hakkar for their unwavering loyalty. The Atal'ai was a once-great troll civilization that was destroyed, its buried artifacts can be found beneath the Pool of Tears. The term "atal'ai" means Devoted Ones in Zandali, the language of the trolls.
Aszune was a night elf princess who, long ago, mocked the Oracle's wisdom. As punishment, she was transformed into living stone. Only the retrieval of her gemstone heart could end the curse.
__NOTOC__ Auchenai Necromancers are draenei of the Auchenai found in Auchenai Crypts.

The Auchenai , pronounced "AW-ken-eye" were the original guardians of the draenei grave-city of Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest. They were called "death priests" and "soulpriests" and their duty for over two hundred years was to take care of the spirits and dead of Auchindoun using the Light. However, all changed following the genocide of the draenei who led Exarch Maladaar to madness, leading him to ordain his death priests to begin practicing necromancy and bring back the dead to serve them. On Azeroth, part of the organization is still present and active in the draenei society.
Ataxon is a voidwalker located at Shadow's Concourse in Eredath.
Atal'ai Devoted are jungle trolls found in De Other Side worshipping Hakkar the Soulflayer.
Ava'zer is a lich leading a company of Undying Bladeguards on a road leading from the Great Veldt into Provis Fauna in Zereth Mortis during A Break in Communication.

:"Though young, Aya took over as the leader of Jade Lotus through her charisma and strategic acumen when her predecessor was accidentally crushed by a jade golem." :— Flavor text Aya Blackpaw is a young pandaren and the secretive leader of the Jade Lotus, one of the three crime families active in Gadgetzan in the Mean Streets of Gadgetzan expansion for Hearthstone. Aya is the last heir of the wealthy Blackpaw family. Using the Gadgetzan Museum of Ancient Artifacts as her headquarters, and shrouding her activities behind her family's reputation as generous philanthropists, she issues orders to the Jade Lotus through her loyal bodyguard and servant, White Eyes, who is incorrectly assumed by ma

Xaxion Drak'eem the ShadowLord was a powerful being who controlled a dungeon full of creatures known as "The Soulless" in the official Blizzard Entertainment scenario map for Warcraft III called WarChasers. He employed powerful monsters: the Kathuulon and Ra'Adoom. He made the mistake of capturing the souls of ancient heroes who eventually killed him, liberating their souls in the process.
Balcephoth of the felshadows is an unknown being who taught Vitus Darkwalker the forbidden secrets of :corruption. He is presumably a demon.

Baku the Mooneater is a giant worm featured in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. Baku is "the great worm" that "basically" serves as a general to Hagatha the Witch. The Witchwood's growing influence drives even the redoubtable citizens of Gilneas to fearful flights of fancy, and they all seem to share the same horrid dream, night after night: a feeling of unspeakable dread as they watch huge, spectral fangs devour the moon. No being akin to Baku exists in any records that describe serpents, dragonhawks, dragons, or other scaled, magical creatures. In fact, Baku has not been seen physically by anyone, instead being observed solely via shared dream visions. One initial hypothesis is
Bajiatha is a saurid located in the Terrace of Sorrows in Nazmir. She summons Clutch Defenders.

Baron Titus Rivendare is a powerful death knight in the service of the Lich King. Originally ruling over the city of Stratholme for the Scourge, he led the Four Horsemen of Naxxramas in place of Highlord Mograine.
__NOTOC__ Baron Aquanis is a water elemental found in the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. He is summoned when a party member tries to collect the Fathom Stone as part of Amongst the Ruins.
Baron Sablemane is a master alchemist who has a workshop is outside the Circle of Blood.
Baron Bloodbane is a rare death knight found in the Eastern Plaguelands. The Plague cauldron he's located at just happens to be the where the original Naxxramas's teleport spire was.
Beast-Haver Chi Chi is a hozen stable master found on Grookin Hill in the Jade Forest. He can be found by the northern entrance to the camp, surrounded by three sleeping Enthralled Forest Prowlers.

Befouler Ahnqat is one of three necromancers of the House of Constructs polluting the air above the uninstanced Necrotic Wake in Bastion during the :Necrolords Campaign. She is located in the southwestern part of the area corresponding to the Final Toll in the instanced Necrotic Wake. __NOTOC__
__NOTOC__ Beltheris was a dreadlord who was slain by Holia Sunshield, Defender of the Scarlet Crusade. Beltheris is summoned by Gul'dan during his encounter in the Nighthold.
Bellmaster Li is a pandaren located at the Gong of Hope, above Forest Heart, in the Jade Forest. According to Maximo's sister, he turns children into bells.

__NOTOC__ Bemora is a draenei Holy paladin. Her Horde counterpart is Seleria Dawncaller. Bemora, Voraatios the Benedictive and Loranea have traveled to Stormwind Harbor bringing Light-Infused Crystals from the Exodar for the Alliance champions shipping off to the Broken Shore.

Bilgewater Blastmasters are goblins located at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar. Prior to the battle for the Broken Shore, they were working on Megaton alongside Underpaid Engineers. They seemed in awe with their bombling creation, as their dialogues indicated, and also worked on Cannons-In-Boxes. Bilgewater Blastmasters were later seen during the battle itself, manning the Cannons-In-Boxes on the beach and fighting with rifles alongside the Horde forces.
__NOTOC__ Birch Tomlin is a worgen located in Tiragarde Sound. He is a harvest-witch.
Blackrock Warlocks are orc warlocks found at the Altar of Storms in the Burning Steppes.
Bladedance is a Shivarra ability. It is the equivalent of the Succubus' Lash of Pain ability.
Blademaster Yozshura is an orc blademaster located atop Mount Volwrath in Talador. Followers challenged him to gain wisdom.

Blamblaster is a gnome caster and tinker. He is known for his spell/invention, "Blamblaster's Super-Explosive Homing Projectile of Doom and Destruction". Casting it is more than a simple arcane missile. The invention reflects his personality: flamboyant, bright, flashy, and half-screwed.

Blighted Soldiers are reanimated undead skeletons of different races found in Tirisfal Glades after the Battle for Lordaeron. They roam through the Lion's Wake, a trail of destruction starting from the Ruins of Lordaeron, running through Brill, and going all the way up to Garren's Haunt and the North Coast.
Blightbone is an abomination and the first boss of the Necrotic Wake.
Blood-Princess Thal'ena is Darkfallen of the San'layn and a boss in Assault on Violet Hold. She is the daughter of Blood-Queen Lana'thel.

__NOTOC__ Blood Witch Najima is a blood troll located in Nazmir. She commands a team of scavengers. After she was killed, Hanzabu invoked her spirit and absorbed it in order to offer her to Bwonsamdi.
__NOTOC__ Blood Witch Pakkala is a blood troll located in Sanctum of Midnight in Nazmir. She is using blood magic on the corpse of Hir'eek.
Bloodmage Thalnos was an elite skeleton mini-boss once found in the Graveyard of the Scarlet Monastery, just below the staircase at the far end of the graveyard itself.
__NOTOC__ Bloodhunter Cursecarvers are blood trolls located in Nazmir. They summon skeletons.
Bloodletter Phantoriax is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Bloodsail Warlocks are humans found in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Bloodwash Enchantresses are naga found in the Blasted Lands. They use blood magic.
Boil Master Yetch is a Maldraxxi necromancer located at Plague Watch in Maldraxxus.
Bonechewer Blood Prophets are fel orcs found in the Black Temple. They use blood magic.
Boneflux is a wildkin located in the Undergorge in Val'sharah. It summons Undulating Boneslimes.
__NOTOC__ Booms is an elite Forsaken mob found on the southwestern side of Unga Ingoo, Krasarang Wilds. Booms commands the powers of a shadow priest and is hostile to players of both factions.
Bonesmith Tolvar is a Maldraxxi necromancer located at Keres' Rest in Maldraxxus.

Bort Fizzwaggle is a gnome mage that was eaten by Meatball, a gnoll encounter in the Brawler's Guild. After Meatball's defeat, the gnome is freed. He then thanks his savior before teleporting to "Bort's Cloud Castle" and disappearing.
Braddok is a jungle troll shaman of the Skullsplitter tribe located at the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe in Northern Stranglethorn.
Brackish is a water elemental located in Island Expeditions.

Bristleback Thorncallers are quilboar thornweavers of the Bristleback tribe found in the Thornsnarl on Red Cloud Mesa. They are responsible for seeding and growing new thorned roots for the quilboar to live in. These thorns mar the land and choke out other life, turning the earth around them barren. The great Cataclysm has driven the Bristlebacks from their dens, and the Thorncallers have begun planting their thorns on Red Cloud Mesa. Adana Thunderhorn asks adventurers to kill the Thorncallers.

__NOTOC__ Brock the Crazed is a worgen shadow priest captain of the Alliance, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Brock or another random Alliance Captain will spawn each time the Alliance reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Brittlebone Skeletons are skeletons that can be summoned by Grobble.
Brittle Shardlings are unbound earth elementals created by the Stone Golem in Drustvar.
Brother Joseph is a human located in the Battle of Dazar'alor. He summons Tempting Sirens.

Brother Sebast was a human and the leader of a group of adventurers who were tricked by Oakwidow into assaulting a mine guarded by ancients. He had in his possession his greatest treasure, a greenish sphere of pure crystal. This item was had the ability to see desired locations.

Bruma Swiftstone is a dwarf subtlety rogue who was found by one of the Alliance champion's followers during the Killing the Corrupted mission and eagerly joined as an additional follower. Her Horde counterpart is Ka'la. She is well known for her way with beasts.
Bubblemaker Ashji is a jinyu at Pearlfin Village in the Jade Forest. They walk around the path with bubblified golfishes.
Bungledorf is the main character in the children's story of The Worst Mage in Dalaran: A Children's Book. His story is about a mage who didn't think he was cut out for the class.
__NOTOC__ Brutus Thornton is a human located at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar. He will occasionally summon Animated Skeletons.
Buried Corpses are ghouls found in the Dawning Wood Catacombs of Duskwood. They spawn when walking over their graves.
Caleesy is a Maldraxxi necromancer located at the Wrangler Pit in Maldraxxus.

Cadaverous is a Maldraxxi necromancer trainee who appears during Training Our Forces (Necrolord), Training in Ardenweald (Necrolord), Training in Bastion (Necrolord), and Training in Revendreth (Necrolord). He'll follow you and assist in combat while in the correct zone for the current training quest.

__NOTOC__ Captain Dargol is a skeletal warrior found in the Agamand Family Crypt in Tirisfal Glades. He is the local leader of the Scourge in the Agamand Mills area of Tirisfal. Dargol is implied to have powers of necromancy, though he only uses melee in battle. Coleman Farthing states that Dargol had a vicious temper when he was alive, and that undeath suits his personality.
.]] Captain Brandon is a human paladin found at Drak'Sotra in Zul'Drak.
Captain Hartford is a notable member of the Scarlet Onslaught, found in Onslaught Harbor. She is a mage and has a rather sharp tongue.
__NOTOC__ Celoenus is a blood elf warlock trainer located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. He is an expert on the summoning of demons.
Chag is a tortollan located in Mangrove Shore in Nazmir. He summons Lucille.

__NOTOC__ Champion Aquaclease is a water elemental located at Foulshore Strip on the Broken Shore. He is accompanied by Aquelian Honor Guards and helps adventurers combat the felfire presence at the Garrison of the Fel as he was instructed by Neptulon. Aquaclease appeared again in Nazjatar, alongside Neptulon and Duke Hydraxis to do battle with the forces of Queen Azshara.
Chaos Mage Beleron is an eredar located at the Shattered Walkway in the Nighthold.

Champion Rin'mar is a lich located in the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus during the initial phase of the Maldraxxus storyline. Much like Champion Gutrend, Rin'mar is a former arena champion seeking to recapture her past glory. __NOTOC__
Chef Cookie is a dead abomination leftover located in the House of Constructs in Maldraxxus. The soul of late "Captain" Cookie, he is found next to Halis's Lunch Pail.
Chiara Coil is a Maldraxxi necromancer walking back and forth between the portal room, the armory, and the southeastern tunnel in the Seat of the Primus.
Chief Bombgineer Snicklefritz is a goblin located in Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds. He summons Snickleblasters.
Christine Gade is a human shieldcrafter at Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands.
__NOTOC__ Chronomancer Delormi is a night elf located in the Caverns of Time.
Claire Willower is a Forsaken found at Brill in the Tirisfal Glades.

Cindermaul, the Portal Master is an earth elemental in the Firelands Forgeworks in Mount Hyjal. He is a crafty elemental that calls forth reinforcements from the other planes. Cindermaul drops a Battered Stone Chest when defeated, which contains the Tome of Openings.
Circle Spellweavers are human mages located at the Circle of Elements in the Arathi Highlands. They are also present during the Battle for Stromgarde.

Clan Ukhel is one of the lesser maruuk centaur clans, located within the Ohn'ahran Plains. In dramatically stark contrast to the other centaur clans, the Ukhel practice necromancy; using the magic to raise the spirits of many bakar and ohuna in The Eternal Kurgans. They have allied with Clan Nokhud, and ultimately commit greater sacrilege by using their dark magic to raise the spirits of long deceased ancestors and khans to fight against the other Centaurs during the Nokhud Offensive. The clan's leader, Gravelord Monkh, attempts to desecrate the spirits of Teera and Maruuk; succeeding in awakening them but not enthralling them. They are soon after killed by the awakened centaur spirits, who
Clint is an undead gnome found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. He came to the island to apply as an intern of a resurrected Dr. Weavil.
Clovercatcher organizes Burlap Trail groups at the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit. He casts Travel Incense on everyone nearby when grummle convoys leave.
__NOTOC__ Clyde is an abomination leftover located in Maldraxxus. He wanted to become a lich, but his soul was too weak.
Conjured Death is a death elemental located in the Tremaculum in the Maw.

:Not to be confused with Constellas. ]] The constellar are a race of mysterious celestial beings who resemble large humanoid-shaped constellations. During the early ages of the universe, when the titan Pantheon brought order to countless planets throughout the Great Dark Beyond, their leader Aman'Thul called upon the constellar to observe the many worlds ordered by the Pantheon. The constellar stayed vigilant for any signs of instability, and, when necessary, initiated a fail-safe procedure to scour a planet of life and reset its evolutionary process.

__NOTOC__ Coral Moongale is a night elf at Bear's Head. While originally allied with the Alliance, she would not actively attack members of the Horde. Since the Cataclysm, Coral became an apprentice of Archmage Xylem and friendly to both factions. She offers no quests or services. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she became a member of Xylem's inner circle. When the adventurer confronted the corrupted archmage, he sent his apprentici to deal with them. When she was defeated, a shadow emerged from her and she came to her senses.
__NOTOC__ Core is an earth elemental affiliated with the Earthen Ring. He, along with The Vortex, Arctanus, and Stikwad, attempt to deal with Lord Magmathar at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.
__NOTOC__ Cor'lat is a lich located in the Grimoirium of the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Corpse Bringer Yal'kar is a blood troll located at the Terrace of the Speakers in Nazmir. She raises Kel'vax Offerings.
Coruscating Voidlords are voidwalkers located in Telogrus Rift.
__NOTOC__ Coursing Tidesurger is a water elemental located in Nazmir during the Faction Assaults. It is summoned by Awakened Tidesages from the Frothing Torrent.

Crusader Lord Valdelmar is an undead found in Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands, and is the former ruler of Tyr's Hand for the Scarlet Crusade. Even in undeath, however, he still appears to be leading Tyr's Hand.

__NOTOC__ Crystal-Shaper Barum is a draenei artificer that shapes crystals and gems. He lived in Aruuna with his daughter Melani. When an Ancient Prism was discovered in the Aruuna Crystal Mine, the Adherents of Rukhmar were attracted to it and destroyed the town without warning, under the delusion that such aritfacts were automatically theirs by self-proclaimed right. Barum fled with Melani; his best friend Kalaam later asked the commander of a new outpost to help them. Barum asked the adventurer to reclaim personal items and one for the legacy of the town, and to make sure they could not be pursued as they fled to The Pilgrim's Road.
Crypt Horrors are crypt fiends located in the Terrorweb Tunnel in the Eastern Plaguelands. They summon Carrion Scarabs.
__NOTOC__ Cultist Necrolytes are humans aligned with the Cult of the Damned found in Farshire in the Borean Tundra.
Cursed Brews are alementals located in the Greenstone Village scenario. They summon Cursed Brew Bubbles.

__NOTOC__ Dahlia Suntouch was the high elf keeper of the Ruby Dragonshrine until she was killed by death knight Orbaz Bloodbane and raised in undeath as a banshee. In service to the Scourge, she became a source of corruption for the shrine.

Dammia Frostcut is a magnataur runemaster. She is a solitary individual who moves from one cave to another in the Dragonblight and, occasionally, other places in Northrend. Other magnataur seek her out for advice, assistance or temporary alliance. She has a voracious appetite, even for a magnataur, and places no limits on the sorts of things she ingests.
Dalronn the Controller is a necromancer boss in Utgarde Keep who accompanies the vrykul Skarvald the Constructor. Both of them will fight at the same time when aggroed.
Dargorr the Landslide was an earth fury located in . It was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.
Dark Ranger Clea is a Darkfallen dark ranger who wanders the Undercity. She is a "seeker" guard, which means that she can see through Stealth effects.

Dark Ranger Cyndia Hawkspear is a Darkfallen dark ranger who wanders the Undercity. She has a patrol path that encompasses a large section of the city, including the Trade Quarter. She is a "seeker" guard, which means that she can see through Stealth effects.
Darkreaver Mor'in is a Darkfallen death knight located at the Axefall in Spires of Arak.

Dartol was the creator of the ever popular . Not much is known about Dartol, except for what Teronis has depicted in his journal. Teronis speaks of an evil wizard, namely Dartol, who attempted to use the rod to deceive the furbolg. His illusion failed, and he was murdered. This 'druidic' wizard, seeking to twist the furbolg for unknown reasons, has a hazy background. It is possible that he came to Kalimdor with Jaina Proudmoore and the refugees from Lordaeron, or he could also have come of his own accord.
Dead Inkgill Priests are deceased jinyu located in Kun-Lai Summit.
Deadwood Den Watchers are furbolgs found in Felpaw Village in Felwood. When at half health, the Watcher will call for help amongst its Deadwood brethren.
Death's Head Necromancer is a quilboar located in Razorfen Downs.
Death Knight Darkreaver was a death knight that lorded over the Great Ossuary in Scholomance. He spawned after the accursed spirits summoned by the Divination Scryer were defeated.

Deathguard Sansa is a Forsaken Deathguard who served under Nathanos Blightcaller as he led a Horde strike team into Stormwind City to rescue the imprisoned Princess Talanji and Prophet Zul of the Zandalari Empire. Following the mission's success, she can be found on Rezan's Wake within Zuldazar.

Deathguard Malcolm is a Forsaken Deathguard who served under Nathanos Blightcaller as he led a Horde strike team into Stormwind City to rescue the imprisoned Princess Talanji and Prophet Zul of the Zandalari Empire. Following the mission's success, he can be found on Rezan's Wake within Zuldazar.

__NOTOC__ Deathguard Razza is a Forsaken standing next to Doras in Orgrimmar during the last stage of the Horde War Campaign. She sought to prevent dissidents within the city from escaping. As Sylvanas Windrunner secured Orgrimmar, she ordered for the arrest of Eitrigg, due to him siding with Varok Saurfang. However should the loyalists side with Eitrigg and defect from Sylvanas, the pair would seek to escape the city and make their their way towards the Orgrimmar Skyway. Upon their arrival Razza, realizing their intentions, declared them traitors and attacked. During the fight she summoned Risen Ghouls to aid her, but was ultimately slain.

Decimatus is the void god created by from the darkened naaru K'ure, in the Sanctum of the Naaru beneath . Adventurers are guided through the Underpale by Vindicator Nobundo or Farseer Drek'Thar to destroy it.

Decindra was one of the One Hundred magi of Arathor. She, Antonius, and their apprentices chose to accompany Thoradin on his quest to find the origins of humanity, which ended in disaster when they broke the seals on the Tomb of Tyr and were killed by Zakajz the Corruptor.

Deephive Summoners are mantid located in the Repository in Mogu'shan Vaults during The Engine of Nalak'sha. They have been busy summoning in the following Old God manifestations: *Summoned Eye *Summoned Maw *Summoned Tentacle

The Defenders of Drustvar are undead spirits present in the Barrowknoll Cemetery of Drustvar. In life, they were valiant champions of Drustvar. During the Drust incursion, a witch from the Heartsbane Coven, named Sister Westwood, summoned their souls to put them into Wicker construct in order to bring death upon the lands they have sworn to protect. Their souls were saved by an Alliance emissary who stopped the rituals and killed the witch.
Demonologist Draan is a man'ari eredar who works for . She is the assistant of Dr. Morrigan and is charging batteries with souls.

Dextren Ward was a level 26 elite human mini-boss in the Stormwind Stockade. He was particularly dangerous because he could cause fear, very deadly in a small cramped instance like The Stockade. It was recommended you cleared all mobs in nearby rooms before attempting him.
Devouring Void was a voidcaller located in a deep chasm found deep in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds. It was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.

Formerly a decorated hero in the First War, Diodor the Damned studied necromancy and eventually became one of the first members of the Cult of the Damned. After leading two successful assaults against the Scarlet Monastery, he was killed when the crusaders figured out his plans and fought back the third (and final) assault. Diodor is mentioned in the Compendium of Fallen Heroes found in Acherus, and is considered a hero by the Scourge.

The necromancer Diesalven is known to have engaged Arellas Fireleaf, High Wizard of the Scarlet Crusade, in a duel. It is not known what transpired between the two, but they were ultimately locked in eternal combat.

Doctor Theolen Krastinov, also known as "The Butcher", is an elite human in the Scholomance. Krastinov is the servant of Kirtonos the Herald, and main torturer and provider of bodies and bodily parts for the Scholomance's necromancy experiments.
:Who would believe fel magic could hide behind such a face? Dizdemona is a gnome warlock, who once attacked Onyxia in her lair.

Dollmaster Dorian is a blood elf puppet maker featured in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. He may be associated with the Crowskin cult, but when an agent was sent to investigate him, what came back was a doppelganger who insisted that Master Dorian is "a very nice man" who "knows what's best". The duplicate was disposed of, but the whereabouts of the missing agent remain unknown.
__NOTOC__ Dolizite is an earth elemental located in Shepherd's Bluff in Stormsong Valley during Faction Assaults.

__NOTOC__ Dr. Terrible was a mad scientist in the Underhalls in Icecrown, more specific in the Hall of Horrors. He was the author of Dr. Terrible's "Building a Better Flesh Giant", and carried out experiments on vargul parts in order to build a powerful Flesh Giants. He created the Flesh Giant Nergeld and wantsed to create an army of these things. However, the adventurer intervened and killed him by using his own creation against him.
Dread Admiral Eliza Goreblade was an undead pirate located in the Temple of a Thousand Lights in Azsuna. Captain of the feared Horizon's Edge, she was the former wielder of the Dreadblades.

Dread Knight Zak'gal is a fel lord appearing during the battle for the Broken Shore. Later, he also appears at Legion Invasion locations, acting as a Legion commander and attacking the regional capitals. During those battles he can summon Fragments of Argus.
Drava'ora is a lich located in the Hall of Ichor of the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus.
AMO was one of the several MOs created by Moe. Similarly to how BMO was made to give love, he was designed to receive it, which ironically made AMO repel it.

Blank-Eyed Girls are members of an unknown species. They first appear in "Blank-Eyed Girl", where they haunt people in the Land of Ooo and reveal their final form. They look like thin clouds in the end.

Cube People are characters that appear in the episode "Gut Grinder." They have bodies made of rectangular shapes and have a small white cube floating above their head. They speak with emotionless robotic-sounding voices. They live inside the Cube Village. The Cube People along with the Soft People and the Spiky People recognized Jake as the Gut Grinder.
Crabbits are a minor species on Adventure Time. They are hybrids of rabbits and crows, as can be seen on their rabbit-like ears, crow-like bodies and beaks, and puffy rabbit-like tails.

Chocolate Rabbit Guy is a candy person who appears in "Slumber Party Panic" as one of the candy zombies. and is revived off-screen. He appears again in The Dark Cloud as a part of the crowd of candy people fighting the Cloud Monster.
Deer are a species of animal found in the real world, often in forests. The first appearance of a major deer in Adventure Time was Stag, a Deer that kidnapped all the Candy People.

Carla is one of the many mutated Super Porp Factory workers. She makes an appearance in the episode "Dark Purple", in which she gets beaten by Susan Strong after she infiltrates the plant. She is shown to desperately want a taste of the Super Porp Syrup, however, never gets one.

Dr. Dextrose is a Candy Person who first appears as a speaker at Princess Bubblegum's science barbecue in "The Real You." He gives a speech on the future of cuteness. When super-smart Finn calls his ideas quaint, Dr. Dextrose gets mad and flashes an evil look at him while muttering to himself.
Dewdrops are a race of little-people that live inside the walls of the Tree Fort.

Doug TenNaple, born July 10, 1966, is an American animator, writer, cartoonist, video game designer, and comic book artist. He helped write the story for the Adventure Time episode, "Sons of Mars." He also helped storyboard a scrapped season one episode, called "The Glorriors." Doug was born in Norwalk, California. Some of his notable works include "[https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Earthworm_Jim Earthworm Jim]," "[https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catscratch Catscratch]," and "[https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghostopolis Ghostoplis]."
Donkeys are a species that appear in the Adventure Time universe. A Donkey first appears in the episode "Who Would Win", being done of The Farm's many farm animals that fell out of his body.

The Gumdrop Dad is a character introduced in "Hug Wolf." He is the father of a teenage gumdrop, and found Finn (as a beta Hug Wolf) in his daughter's room in the middle of the night. He mistakes Finn for a "hairy teenager," and uses his candy cane shotgun to try to kill him. Finn narrowly escapes being shot by jumping out of the window. Gumdrop Dad then yells out to him, saying that his daughter will never marry.

Geneva Hodgson, born May 31, 1987, is an American animator, artist, and writer. She did the storyboarding for the Adventure Time mini-episode, "Sow, Do You Like Them Apples. Geneva is known for making many of her own online mini-comics, which can be found on her Twitter and Tumblr. Some of her other notable works include "OK K.O.! Let’s be Heroes," "Tattletail," and "Teen Titans Go!."
Hatey Von Hatenstein is a gag character, used to make a joke in Issue 74.

Lumpy Space Dad (Formerly known as Lumpy Space King) is the former king of Lumpy Space. He makes his first appearance in "Trouble in Lumpy Space." He is Lumpy Space Princess's father and the husband of Lumpy Space Queen. In the episode, he is seen driving home and yelling at his daughter for bringing "smooth people" into their world. He later bans Lumpy Space Princess from using the family car because she yelled at her mother. He seems to refer to LSP only as "daughter." He also makes a brief appearance at the end of "The Duke," during the Grand Meeting of Ooo Royalty, and in "The Eyes," dancing at LSP's quinceañera. He appears to be over-protective and strict. He once referred to their car

The Lyre Player (also known as the Minstrel) is a character in Adventure Time who appears in the episodes "Rainy Day Daydream" and "Blood Under the Skin." He lives in Finn's imagination land, where he welcomes Finn with a silly song and a dance. Finn finds him annoying, so Finn imagines a penguin that trips him and a plate of spaghetti for his face to fall into. He returns as Sir Slicer's minstrel in "Blood Under the Skin," playing and singing the song "Finn the Blushing Baby." According to Sir Slicer, grandparents will sing that song to their grandchildren for generations to come, despite Finn's disapproval. The Lyre Player has a cameo appearance in "Blade of Grass," where he can be briefly

Lizard Princess (or Reptile Princess) is a character who makes a cameo in the Season One episode "What is Life?" in Ice King's Imagination Zone. She is located between Space Angel Princess and Mini Queen. She later reappears in the Season Six episode "Breezy". She is the ruler of the Lizard Kingdom.
Jelly Horses are a species of candy horses that appear in both the Candy Kingdom and in Gumbaldia.

The Earl of Lemongrab (referred to as "Lemongrab 2" in this article) is a clone of the Earl of Lemongrab, created by Princess Bubblegum to cure the loneliness felt by the original (whom she also created). The Lemongrabs resided in Castle Lemongrab, where they jointly ruled the Earldom. However, as of "Lemonhope Part 2," they were both destroyed by Lemonhope and then merged to create Lemongrab 3.

The Messenger is Flame King's personal messenger and servant. In "Earth & Water," he brings word of Flame Princess' potential for power. Flame King, fearing usurpation, orders him to take his baby daughter into the wilderness and leave her there to perish. Unable to bring himself to do so, the Messenger instead gives her to a Rock Woodsman and cries from the sudden separation.

Mr. Chocoberry is a minor character in the episode "Bad Little Boy", he is the gender counterpart of Chocoberry. He appears bathing in a bathtub at Lumpy Space Prince's party. He is in a romantic relationship with Ms. Cupcake, as implied in Fionna's dream in "Casper & Nova", being her husband.

Raggedy Princess makes her debut in "Prisoners of Love", wherein she is kidnapped by Ice King. She also appears briefly at the meeting of Ooo royalty in "The Duke", "Mortal Recoil", and in "Loyalty to the King". She also appears in "Apple Thief", wherein she is seen lying down in a ditch. She tends to giggle while speaking to Finn, implying that she has a crush on him like several other princesses. In "Breezy", she was at Crab Princess's party, but she can't reach the juice on her lap because she doesn't have any arms (though she has arms in "Princess Day"). It is revealed in "Princess Day" that she is considered a registered princess. Raggedy Princess is allegedly the princess of the Ooo Ju
Rainicorns are a species of rainbow/unicorn creatures that live in peace in the Land of Ooo and also the Crystal Dimension.
Plop-Top (also known as Dump-Dome) is the second youngest of the Lemon Children of Lemongrab and Lemongrab 2 and makes its first appearance in "All Your Fault."

Princess Business is a princess briefly mentioned by Breakfast Princess in "Princess Day". She was present in Breakfast Kingdom during the annual Princess Day. Very little is known about her, including her physical appearance, the kingdom in which she resides, and the people she rules.
Polly Lou Tanglehorn is a minor character on Adventure Time: Side Quests, appearing in the episode "Storm Rider".

Olivia Rose Olson is an American singer and actress who voices Marceline in Adventure Time. She has also done voice acting on as Vanessa Doofenshmirtz and as Bliss. Her adoptive father Martin Olson, who is also a screenwriter from Phineas and Ferb, voices Marceline's father Hunson Abadeer. She has posted videos of her singing on YouTube; her original songs include: "Sunny," "Loving You And Me," "Your Friend," "Sick 'n Tired," "Barriers," and "Suspicious." In 2018, Olivia Olson released her second album, Nowhere Land.

Sharon is a Spiky Person seen in "Gut Grinder". She is the wife of Spiky Mayor. She was also the monstrous Gut Grinder, a costume she used to steal gold from nearby villages. After being caught, Sharon admitted she wanted the gold to buy things. She was then thrown into the spiky jail. She also acts like a teenager.

Snow Golems are creatures made of snow that live in the Ice Kingdom. Many of them were created by the Ice King, but it is unknown whether he made all of them. The most prominent Snow Golem is the one featured in "Thank You."

Torcho is the niece of Flame King. Her father was killed by her uncle in order to seize power, so she and her brother, Furnius, attempted to assassinate him by pouring ice into his ear. Torcho and Furnius are disguised as executors of the Flame King and were also ordered by the Flame King to execute both Finn and Jake, but they were foiled by Finn and Jake who identified Torcho by her untied shoe. She was subsequently sent to the punishment room by her uncle. Their true fates remain unknown until Torcho is shown to be alive in Pirates of the Enchiridion. Torcho first appears in "Ignition Point."

The Woobeewoo villagers (also called Mudscamps) are a species who appear in "The Hard Easy." Finn and Jake help them deal with Prince Huge. They look like fish with two legs, and they produce stink oil out of their awful-sauce glands. Woobeewoo is the only mudscamp who is named. They live in and on small round huts in a swamp. Their village does not have an official name, but Woobeewoo calls it "South Woobeewoo." They are lead by the Woobeewoo Elder who wears a bell on his head as his token of office and always has two advisers under foot who have been known to correct his grammar. They fear having to move to the city to get jobs as their people don't know how to be cool. They were later men
* Baerauble Etharr, future friend of the elves of Cormanthor and Court mage of Cormyr.

__NOTOC__ * Ali el Samesaj rescues the daughter of a Drakhon sultan of Calimshan from kidnappers. Her grandfather, Syl-Pasha Adjam el Drakhon, rewards him by raising him to the sultan's court, where he becomes the unofficial court wizard.
* Thayd, a Theurgist Adept, leads a group of mages in a rebellion against the empires of Mulhorand and Unther. Thayd claims the northern provinces of both for himself.
* Hetel Hastalhorn, a noted archmage of Halruaa, establishes Mhairhetel on the southern edge of the Mhair Jungles.
* In Myratma, Akkabar el Shoon is born to a Calishite noble and a favorite harem girl. They return to their home in Memnon.
* During the Seventh Serôs War, the storm giant adventurer Lorthar of the Waves wields the once-lost Krakenscourge.

* Lashia the Dagger executes two of her students when they create a mythallar. She places a blanket ban on mythallar-powered quasimagical items. She decrees that anyone caught with one in Dagger's Point will be punished with a severe beating or death.
* Archwizard Chever is driven insane by repeated contact with an extraplanar being. He throws himself into a sphere of annihilation.

*Borem of the Boiling Mud, one of the Seven Lost Gods, becomes active after long years of inactivity as a muddy river, growing into a lake. There he is slain by a trio of adventurers—Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul—who bear his heart from the area around Mulmaster north towards Cormanthor.
* Nardrad Orgolath, the Nentyarch of Narfell, dies. His son Orlathaun dies later in the year, ending the Orgolath Dynasty.
* Princess Darseera vanishes without a trace at night from the gardens of her father's keep in the Purple Hills. The ballad "Lost Princess Road" is written about her disappearance.
* Vayloss Talanthil II, the fifth Sorcerer–Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, dies.
* Soss, a Rashemi warrior, leads some of his clan northwards, exploring and trading with Dareth's dwarves. They settle in the valleys of the Armridge Mountains, and eventually become the Sossrim.
* A monster nicknamed Diemondar ("jaws of death" in Loross) begins attacking fishing vessels in Basin Lake. Though numerous hunters search for it, it is cunning enough to elude them.
* The arcanist Lashia the Dagger wrests control of a part of Dagger's Point from the thugs and thieves that inhabit it. She establishes a school that teaches both thievery and magic.
* Shemen, the chieftain of a Raumviran tribe dies. His followers name the lands they have claimed Rashemen ("lands of Shemen") and name themselves "Rashemi" in his honor..
* Faerlthann Obarskyr, first king of Cormyr. * Yvonnel Baenre becomes matron mother of House Baenre, beginning a reign that will last nearly a millennia and a half.
* Corlarth Talanthil, the second Sorcerer–Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, dies.
* Archwizard Buoyance attempts to covertly assassinate Archwizard Karsus but immediately backs off as soon as he realizes that he's drastically underestimated the young magical savant.
* Laszik Silvermind disappears, believed by many to have ascended to serve the god Auppenser.
* The legendary hero-king of Ammarindar, King Olaurin is killed by the deep dragon Erthungaron.
* Desva, leader of the Ghostwise halfling tribe, is killed in battle by Chand, warchief of the Strongheart tribe. ;Short Stories * Realms of War ** Weasel's Run
*Birth of famous Shou scholar, political advisor and moral philosopher Lao Chin-Mao.
__NOTOC__ * Nentyarch Arthauld "the Accursed" of Narfell dies. He is succeeded by his son Belevan "the Unliving".
* Arthauld Crell, a future Nentyarch of Narfell, is born to his father Derevon.
__NOTOC__ * Arkhan Umathar II, second ruler of the Nhalass Dynasty of Raumathar, dies.
__NOTOC__ * Arkhan Umathar III, third ruler of the Nhalass Dynasty of Raumathar, dies.
* The arcanist Xanad is born in Netheril, with a life of magic and villainy waiting for him.
* Cedric Carrathal, future king of Callidyrr in the Moonshae Isles, is born as the grandson of King Adrian Carrathal.
* Edwin Carrathal is born as the third son of Queen Yolanda and King Bertrand Carrathal of Callidyrr.
* Viledel "the Seaking" unites all of the islands of the Korinn Archipelago into a single polity.
* Adrian Carrathal, future king of Callidyrr, is born as the sole heir to Prince Edwin Carrathal II.
* Vance Carrathal, future king of Callidyrr in the Moonshae Isles, is born to Prince Cedric Carrathal.
* Bethany Carrathal, future queen of Callidyrr, is born to Prince Edwin I.
* The vampire Saed, lord of Vaelan, unites the beast-chieftains of Veldorn under his rule.

* After wandering the Sands of Itzcala in Maztica for a year, the shaman Tecco journeys into the heights of the Axapoztlan Range. He enters a cave where he is visited by the god Zaltec. Zaltec orders Tecco to lead the Nahuat people south and claim the lands there for themselves.
* Dagult Neverember arrives in Neverwinter and soon becomes its Lord Protector, a position from which he can begin to rebuild the city.

* Talaric Daoran, despite the agreement between the people of Phlan and the fey of the Quivering Forest, sends loggers into the woods. The next day, he goes missing from Valjevo Castle, never to be seen again.
* Qilué Veladorn is born through the intervention of the goddess Mystra. She is the seventh of the Seven Sisters, mortal servants of the goddess. * The Temptation of Elminster ends

* In Silverhand Tower outside Neverwinter, Dove Falconhand is born to Dornal Silverhand and Elué Shundar through the intervention of the goddess Mystra. She is the third of the Seven Sisters, mortal servants of the goddess.
* Alledec of Ilmater, the lifelong priest and the creator of the Three White Doves, dies peacefully in his sleep, three years after completing his masterpiece.

* High Lady Mage Elué Dualen abruptly abandons her rule of Silverymoon, along with Lynnasha "Lynx" Nharimlur and Tulrun of the Tent. Warlord Lashtor seizes power in her absence, and persecute the city's mages.

Abdel Adrian was an adventurer who traveled extensively across west Faerûn, thrice saving it from ruin during the mid–14 century DR. As one of the mortal progenies of the dead god Bhaal, he lived for over a hundred years well into the late 15 century. Abdel spent most of his extended life in the city of Baldur's Gate, where he served as a soldier and general of the Flaming Fist, as well as a beloved statesman of the Council of Four.

Abbathor ( ) was the neutral evil dwarven god of greed and for a time in the 1400s DR an exarch of Bane. The Great Master of Greed represented the major weakness of dwarvenkind, the treasurelust that was their worst aspect. The Trove Lord was once concerned with the natural beauty of gems, but after being denied the position he had coveted since birth, he abandoned dwarven honor for trickery and would do whatever it took to never be denied again.
Aarin Gend of Neverwinter was Lord Nasher's personal spymaster in the mid–14 century DR.

Aasimar were human-based planetouched, native outsiders that had in their blood some good, otherworldly characteristics. They were often, but not always, descended from celestials and other creatures of pure good alignment, but while predisposed to good alignments, aasimar were by no means always good.

* The famous ranger hero Yornar "the Tracker" disappears. Although signs of his passing are found for the next three years, he is never seen again and no remains are ever found. Followers of Mielikki believe that he still lives as the personal servant of the goddess.
* The tiefling Khamune leads an uprising in Pyarados against Mulhorand. His rebellion is crushed. * Khamune and Greta Zann are slain by the Mulhorandi.

Abishai (; ), also known as scaly devils, were baatezu in service to the Queen of Chromatic Dragons, Tiamat. The draconic devils were, among many other roles, the guards and escorts of the Nine Hells' captives, processing them for torture when not corrupting mortals themselves. Among most scholars, abishai were considered the lowest-ranked of the lesser baatezu.
Accalia was a female human priest from the Temple of Tempus in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale.
Achaierais ( ; ) were a race of foul fowl native to Acheron that were also known to inhabit the Barrens of Doom and Despair.
